Madrid is a leading European capital. Our students benefit from a global learning environment, top-tier networking opportunities and buildings equipped with state-of-the-art facilities – all shared with the prestigious top-ranked IE Business School.

At IE, students learn from experts with experience at companies such as PwC, Save the Children, Google, and the UN. They engage in policy simulations, internships, and real-world projects with NGOs, law firms, and multilateral organizations.
